variants.A: Full Qwen visual encode + full semantic decode for every changed observation
variants.B: Dedicated lightweight visual embedding encoder + calibrated MVC + Qwen decode on escalation
variants.C: One Qwen/libmtmd encode + merged-feature MVC-M0 + same-encode Qwen decode on escalation
variants.D: One Qwen/libmtmd encode + tiny projection MVC-M1 + same-encode Qwen decode on escalation
variants.E: Optional same-Qwen-encode pre-merger+merged dual-view MVC-M2; run only if C/D miss gate

corpus_requirements: near-neighbor unknown states deliberately similar to known states
test_obligations.statistical_law: Preserve raw rows, matched inputs/seeds where stochasticity exists, warm/cold separation, outliers and all available machine/runtime/model metadata. No promotion from mean-only summaries.

test_obligations.purpose: Determine whether visual prototype geometry survives runtime/preprocessing changes.
matrix_axes: CPU vs CUDA vs Vulkan only where target/available
measurements: token count and spatial grid identity
test_obligations.decision: If a compatibility change produces material feature/behavior drift, namespace prototypes by the new VisualEncoderCompatibilityID and require re-admission/recalibration; never silently migrate.

test_obligations.purpose: Validate canonical pixel identity before cheap unchanged-frame gating and prototype admission.
cases: same rendered pixels across PNG/JPEG/WebP where loss permits tolerance
scaled UI with same semantic state
cursor-only motion separated from action-critical content
test_obligations.acceptance: Visually equivalent canonicalized inputs should share the intended identity; semantically/action-relevant visual differences must not be collapsed.

test_obligations.purpose: Treat multimodal runtime failure as observable/recoverable rather than silent perception corruption.
test_obligations.required_behavior: Fail closed for consequential effects, mark perception DEGRADED/UNKNOWN, quarantine incompatible MVC state, recover from last-known-good, then revalidate before HEALTHY.
